SELECT id AS id, service_name AS serviceName, owner_user AS ownerUser, owner_user_name AS ownerUserName, cross_tenantis_allowed AS crossTenantIsAllowed, description AS description, maintenance_filed AS maintenanceFiled FROM service_maintenance WHERE deleted = 0
AND id = #{params.id}
AND service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.serviceName}, '%')
AND owner_user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.ownerUserName}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_business sb WHERE sb.service_id = service_maintenance.id AND sb.business_id = #{params.businessId})

SELECT DISTINCT sm.id AS id, sm.service_name AS serviceName, sm.owner_user AS ownerUser, sm.owner_user_name AS ownerUserName, sm.cross_tenantis_allowed AS crossTenantIsAllowed, sm.description AS description, sm.maintenance_filed AS maintenanceFiled FROM service_maintenance sm INNER JOIN service_business sb ON sm.id = sb.service_id INNER JOIN sys_business_product sbp ON sb.business_id = sbp.business_id AND sbp.deleted = 0 WHERE sm.deleted = 0 AND sbp.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
